title: TONSTAD bed frame with storage
description: TONSTAD bed frame with storage, brown stained oak veneer/Lyngör dark gray, Queen Classic design meets a graceful finish in the TONSTAD series. Spacious soft-closing drawers under the bed – and LYNGÖR mattress base gives extra height and helps your mattress keep its shape for longer.
features: Comprises: 1 bed frame, 1 LYNGÖR mattress base, 1 LYNGÖR mattress base cover and 1 SKORVA midbeam.
Mattress and bedlinens are sold separately.
More information about each product in the set can be found on each product page on .us.
